content: I/O Hardware Abstraction abstracts from the location of peripheral I/O devices The I/O Hardware Abstraction abstracts from the location of peripheral I/O devices (on-chip or on- board) and the ECU hardware layout and has therefore dependencies to ECU Hardware described by HwElement s. In ad- dition, the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType is a hybrid concept sharing features of both software-components and basic software modules.
